title: Append-only log
prompt: Implement `static void AppendLine(string path, string line)` (appends one line, creating the file if needed) and `static string[] ReadLines(string path)` (all lines; empty array for a missing file, never null).

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Each append lands after the last; order survives.

tests.name: missing
tests.hint: Read-before-write must not crash the log viewer; append bootstraps the file.
